title: Crispy Chicken Kebabs with German Twist
description: A delicious and easy-to-make dish that combines the flavors of German cuisine with the convenience of chicken kebabs.
instructions: Cut the chicken breast into bite-sized pieces and season with german mustard, jazzy salt, and crispy breadcrumbs.
Thread the chicken pieces onto the kebabs.
Drizzle the olive oil over the kebabs and toss to coat.
Place the kebabs on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through and the breadcrumbs are crispy.
